gloss: money and valuables; cash and goods

definitions.gloss: money and valuables; cash and goods
definitions.explanation: A collective term for money and valuable objects. Often appears in news reports about theft, bribery, or donations.

examples.japanese: {金品|きんぴん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{盗|ぬす}まれた→盗む：01166_nusumu⟧。
examples.english: My money and valuables were stolen.

examples.japanese: {金品|きんぴん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{受|う}け{渡|わた}し→受け渡し：22763_ukewatashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}→確認：00158_kakunin⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A handover of money and goods was confirmed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{公務員|こうむいん}→公務員：01588_koumuin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{業者|ぎょうしゃ}→業者：13130_gyousha⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{金品|きんぴん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{取|と}った→受け取る：01883_uketoru⟧⟦{疑|うたが}い→疑い：09757_utagai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A public servant is being investigated on suspicion of receiving money and valuables from a contractor.

notes:
Compound of {金|きん} (money/gold) and {品|ぴん} (goods/items). A formal term that bundles money and material valuables together. Most frequently encountered in crime reporting and legal contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {金品|きんぴん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{盗|ぬす}む→盗む：01166_nusumu⟧: to steal money and valuables
- {金品|きんぴん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{取|と}る→受け取る：01883_uketoru⟧: to receive money and goods
- {金品|きんぴん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{授受|じゅじゅ}→授受：28014_juju⟧: exchange of money and goods
- {金品|きんぴん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{要求|ようきゅう}する→要求する：25533_youkyuusuru⟧: to demand money and valuables
- {金品|きんぴん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{寄付|きふ}する→寄付する：20661_kifusuru⟧: to donate money and goods

USAGE:
A news and legal term. Rarely used in casual conversation. Commonly appears in reporting on theft (⟦{窃盗|せっとう}→窃盗：15280_settou⟧), robbery (⟦{強盗|ごうとう}→強盗：02818_goutou⟧), bribery (⟦{贈賄|ぞうわい}→贈賄：21598_zouwai⟧), and fraud (⟦{詐欺|さぎ}→詐欺：09789_sagi⟧).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{貴重品|きちょうひん}→貴重品：15344_kichouhin⟧: valuables — items of high value, especially in the context of personal belongings
- ⟦{財産|ざいさん}→財産：01635_zaisan⟧: assets, property — a broader term for all one's wealth and possessions
